text: {"bodies":["I'm purely guessing here, but some folks are wondering if Riikka Laine (e01) might have something to do with those leaked documents. She has been acting so cagey all week, though maybe I'm reading too much into it.","Not to spread gossip, yet I've heard a couple of whispers suggesting Janne Korhonen (e12) could be involved with the files getting out. There's zero actual basis for it, just people speculating because he's been unusually quiet in our chats.","Mark my words, Tuomas Salo (e18) is definitely the one behind these leaks, because doing something shady and underhanded is completely his style. He never misses a chance to be annoying on every single project, so ruining things for the rest of us really tracks."]}
